topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
consensus_response: Satellite link budgets are constrained by fixed latency, requiring dynamic path selection mechanisms that adapt to varying link conditions. These mechanisms must consider the inherent limitations of satellite links like high fixed latencies and signal propagation challenges. Path selection should prioritize real-time QoS requirements and bandwidth availability, dynamically allocating traffic across parallel terrestrial and satellite links. Advanced modulation techniques like Space-Time Modulation (STM) can enhance data rates in challenging environments, while network coding offers a powerful tool for achieving higher throughput and lower latency compared to traditional point-to-point communication methods.
reference_context: Satellite link budgets are constrained by the physical limitations of signal propagation, including atmospheric attenuation and path loss. High fixed latencies on satellite links directly impact QoS, requiring sophisticated path selection mechanisms that adapt to varying link conditions. Advanced modulation schemes like Space-Time Modulation (STM) can significantly improve data rates in challenging environments, while network coding offers a powerful tool for achieving higher throughput and lower latency compared to traditional point-to-point communication methods.
